description: Angular component for editing widgets in the Thingsboard platform, including code editors, layout, and widget configuration management.

classes.name: WidgetEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for widget editing, including code editors, layout, and widget configuration management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes widget data and user permissions based on route data.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Sets up layout, editors, and iframe on component initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners, editors, and subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: initHotKeys
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for widget editing actions.

methods.name: initSplitLayout
methods.description: Initializes split layout for the editor panels.

methods.name: initAceEditors
methods.description: Creates and configures ACE code editors for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

methods.name: setAceEditorValues
methods.description: Sets initial values in ACE editors from widget data.

methods.name: createAceEditor
methods.description: Creates an ACE editor instance with specified mode.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for ACE editors.

methods.name: onWindowMessage
methods.description: Handles messages from iframe for widget editing events and errors.

methods.name: onWidgetEditModeInited
methods.description: Handles initialization of widget edit mode.

methods.name: onWidgetEditUpdated
methods.description: Updates widget data after editing in iframe.

methods.name: onWidgetEditModeToggled
methods.description: Toggles widget edit mode.

methods.name: onWidgetException
methods.description: Handles exceptions reported from widget iframe.

methods.name: cleanupJsErrors
methods.description: Removes JavaScript error markers and annotations.

methods.name: commitSaveWidget
methods.description: Saves widget type details and updates route on success.

methods.name: commitSaveWidgetAs
methods.description: Saves widget as new type and navigates accordingly.

methods.name: setWidgetTypeDetails
methods.description: Updates widget type details and clones widget data.

methods.name: applyWidgetScript
methods.description: Applies current widget script and reloads iframe.

methods.name: undoWidget
methods.description: Reverts widget to original state.

methods.name: saveWidget
methods.description: Triggers save operation if widget has a name.

methods.name: saveWidgetAs
methods.description: Triggers 'save as' operation.

methods.name: undoDisabled
methods.description: Checks if undo action is disabled.

methods.name: saveDisabled
methods.description: Checks if save action is disabled.

methods.name: saveAsDisabled
methods.description: Checks if 'save as' action is disabled.

methods.name: beautifyCss
methods.description: Beautifies CSS code in the widget.

methods.name: beautifyHtml
methods.description: Beautifies HTML code in the widget.

methods.name: beautifyJs
methods.description: Beautifies JavaScript code in the widget.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a resource URL from widget resources.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a new resource URL to widget resources.

methods.name: widgetTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles change in widget type and updates default config accordingly.

methods.name: settingsFormUpdated
methods.description: Marks form as dirty and updates script completers.

methods.name: dataKeySettingsFormUpdated
methods.description: Marks data key form as dirty.

methods.name: latestDataKeySettingsFormUpdated
methods.description: Marks latest data key form as dirty.

methods.name: editControllerScriptModules
methods.description: Opens modal to edit controller script modules.

methods.name: get controllerScriptBody
methods.description: Getter for controller script body.

methods.name: set controllerScriptBody
methods.description: Setter for controller script body.

methods.name: get controllerScriptModules
methods.description: Getter for controller script modules.

methods.name: set controllerScriptModules
methods.description: Setter for controller script modules.

methods.name: get confirmOnExitMessage
methods.description: Provides message to confirm exit if widget is dirty.

methods.name: updateControllerScriptCompleters
methods.description: Loads and updates code completion suggestions for controller scripts.
